name: gymscore-local
description: Offline-first, lokales Sport-Assessment-System für Schulen und Vereine

scripts.dev:server: tsup src/server/server.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/server --external better-sqlite3 --watch --onSuccess "node dist/server/server.js"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,DESKTOP,HELPER" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:helper"
scripts.build:server: tsup src/server/index.ts src/server/server.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/server --external better-sqlite3
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/main --external electron,better-sqlite3
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:helper
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n "VITE,SERVER,ELECTRON" -c "green,blue,magenta" "vite" "tsup src/server/server.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/server --external better-sqlite3 --watch --onSuccess \"node dist/server/server.js\"" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:main && electron ."

author: GymScore Local Team
